run_cli_main: run the main CLI entry point to dispatch registered commands with auto-generated argparse arguments
build_cli_command: build a new CLI command function with type-annotated parameters that auto-register as argparse arguments
create_data_manager: create a DataManager instance that is automatically injected into CLI commands annotated with DataManager
refactor_cli_dispatcher: refactor the CLI dispatcher to support additional type annotations for custom argument parsing behavior
review_cli_signature_parsing: review the signature-based argument parsing logic that maps function parameters to CLI flags and positional args
